title: VooPoo Argus E40 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Argus E40 Pod Kit is an advanced vaping device designed to provide a versatile and satisfying vaping experience. Featuring Voopoo’s innovative PnP X technology platform, the Argus E40 supports multiple vaping styles, including MTL (mouth-to-lung), RDL (restricted direct-to-lung), and DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping. The PnP X technology enhances flavour production, prevents leakage, and extends coil lifespan, making your vaping experience more enjoyable. This flexibility makes it an excellent choice for both beginners and experienced adult vapers. Powered by a built-in 1800mAh battery , the Argus E40 offers an adjustable wattage output from 5 to 40W , allowing you to precisely customize your vape to find your ideal flavour intensity and draw. The device charges quickly via USB Type-C with 2A fast charging, ensuring minimal downtime. The Argus E40 kit includes two E40 cartridges with different coil resistances: 0.3ohm (best for DTL) and 0.6ohm (RDTL), both with a 2ml e-liquid capacity. The device features a crisp OLED screen that displays essential information such as battery life, wattage, and coil resistance. The stepless airflow adjustment allows for precise control over your vaping style, ensuring a smooth, flavoursome, and consistent draw every time. Pair this kit with a vape liquid that delivers the perfect balance of flavour and performance. How to Use the Voopoo Argus E40: 1. Remove the cartridge from the device. 2. Fill the cartridge with your preferred e-liquid, ensuring it is filled to at least 2/3 capacity. 3. Allow the cartridge to sit for 5 minutes to let the coil saturate. 4. Insert the cartridge back into the device. 5. Adjust the wattage and airflow to your preference. 6. Inhale to activate and enjoy your vape. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for five to ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
